sections.title: Decisive and Categorical Denial
sections.content: You know *korántsem* from B2 Culture Unit 1 and B2 Unit 13, so this lesson is a recap with examples about licensed criticism. The emphatic negative adverbial particle korántsem ('by no means / far from it / anything but') decisively refutes an assertion or assumed state of affairs. It modifies adjectives, adverbs, or verbs, stressing that reality is vastly different from an optimistic or simplistic assumption.

sections.title: Register and Syntactic Behavior
sections.content: Korántsem belongs to the formal, analytical, and critical register of Hungarian. It already carries the negation, so it never takes an additional 'nem', whether it modifies an adjective ('korántsem egyszerű' = far from simple), an adverb or a verb. With a verb it precedes the finite verb or the focal element.

sections.title: Emphatic Refutation with korántsem
rows: A szelephumor korántsem jelentett valódi szólásszabadságot.
Safety-valve humor by no means meant genuine freedom of speech.
Hofi szerepe korántsem volt egyértelmű a korszak politikai életében.
Hofi's role was far from unambiguous in the political life of the era.
A pártvezetés korántsem nézte mindig jó szemmel a maró poénokat.
The party leadership by no means always looked favorably on the scathing punchlines.
A gazdasági helyzet korántsem volt olyan fényes, mint ahogyan a hírek állították.
The economic situation was far from as bright as the news claimed.

items.spanish: A Mikroszkóp Színpad előadásai korántsem voltak mentesek a cenzori beavatkozástól.
items.english: The performances of the Mikroszkóp Színpad were by no means free from censorial intervention.

items.spanish: Hofi sikere korántsem a véletlennek, hanem rendkívüli őszinteségének és tehetségének volt köszönhető.
items.english: Hofi's success was by no means due to chance, but to his extraordinary sincerity and talent.

items.spanish: A szocialista tervgazdaság hibái korántsem maradtak észrevétlenek a nézők előtt.
items.english: The flaws of the socialist planned economy by no means remained unnoticed before the spectators.

sections.title: B2 Usage Notice
sections.content: Never write '*korántsem nem szép'. Use 'korántsem szép' (far from beautiful). Korántsem already carries the negative value!
